title: helianthemum niloticum subsp. papillare
intro: Helianthemum niloticum subsp. papillare, commonly known as rockrose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Cistaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of rockrose include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic activities, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The health benefits of rockrose are thought to be due to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activity.
